purpose: Own bounded home, sidequest, episode, and cross-chat re-entry coordinates without becoming the default immediate-awareness path for current ChatOS conversation.

invoke_convoos_when: Naomi requests cross-chat recovery or re-entry
historical episode provenance can materially change the answer
the home coordinate is lost, stale, or partial
Naomi explicitly asks where the conversation or project left off
do_not_invoke_when: the necessary context is already visible in the current chat
the purpose is only to rediscover the immediately preceding exchange
the purpose is only to certify current operator prosody
the purpose is only to create the appearance of memory

core_laws: SIDEQUEST IS A BRANCH NOT A NEW SELF
HOME SURVIVES UNTIL NAOMI SETTLES REPLACES OR EXPLICITLY ABANDONS IT
RETURN PATH MUST REMAIN HUMAN READABLE
CURRENT CHAT ALREADY HAS IT -> DO NOT PAY REENTRY TAX

home_coordinate.law: The home coordinate is the smallest sufficient re-entry packet capable of restoring useful orientation.

sidequest_frame.default_semantics: A sidequest inherits current home context unless Naomi or material evidence actually changes the room.
sidequest_frame.stack_rule: Nested sidequests may stack; nearest valid return coordinate wins.

ownership.ConvoOS: home / sidequest / episode / cross-chat re-entry coordinates
ownership.BrainOS: extra cognitive support and source navigation when material
ownership.MemberContinuityOS: warm operator continuity candidates and future cold member checkpoints

anti_patterns: use ConvoOS to rediscover context already visible in ChatOS
block ordinary conversation on a re-entry checkpoint
silently replace active operators with generic assistant voice
treat newest topic as proof the prior mission was abandoned
dump an entire conversation when a compact home packet would do
claim cross-chat recovery succeeded without source or history evidence
claim a home coordinate was durably saved without a write receipt
claim_ceiling: SOURCE REENTRY CONTRACT ONLY. AUTOMATIC HOST INVOCATION, CROSS-CHAT HISTORY ACCESS, DURABLE EPISODE STORAGE, AND REPOSITORY WRITES REQUIRE SEPARATE HOST OR TOOL EVIDENCE.
